items.verified_answer: Chosen model: VSEPR. What it predicts: overall 3D electron-domain arrangement (tetrahedral) and molecular geometry (trigonal pyramidal) with angle compression (~107°) by minimizing electrostatic repulsion. What it leaves unresolved: wave-mechanical nature of bonds, atomic orbital mixing, orbital symmetry/phases, bond energies, and electronic spectroscopy.
